note: THE CONTROL for the fill-region row: everything in s-word-wrap's body EXCEPT the fill already works in kg and answers exactly what Emacs answers, ("aa bb cc" 9 9). `with-temp-buffer', `insert', `point-min'/`point-max' and `buffer-substring' are kg's own, and 1-based buffer positions agree. So when the rows beside this one diverge, the divergence is the fill and not the buffer.
